name: Incident retrospective drafter
description: Collect incident chatter and issue updates, then draft a timeline and follow-up checklist.

onUnsupported.message: This deployment cannot run automations that call MCP tools, so the incident retrospective drafter is unavailable here.

integrations.reason: Reads follow-up tickets, owners, and status.

onUnmet.message: Connect Slack and Linear before continuing. Notion can be connected later during setup.

onWarn.message: Notion is not connected yet. The agent will help you connect it or choose another destination.

form.note: These answers start the conversation. Anything left blank is something the agent will ask about.

fields.name: incidentChannel
fields.label: Incident channel
fields.help: The Slack channel where incidents are discussed.

fields.name: linearTeam
fields.label: Linear team
fields.help: The team whose follow-up tickets belong in the retrospective.

fields.name: notionDestination
fields.label: Notion destination
fields.help: Page or database where drafts should be published. Leave blank to decide during setup.

fields.name: triggerPreference
fields.label: How should it run?
fields.help: A starting preference only. The agent confirms the exact trigger before creating anything.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Anything else the agent should know?
fields.help: Incident naming conventions, an existing retro template, who should be notified.

review.title: Start the setup conversation
review.note: Setup finishes in a conversation with an agent. You can change any of this while you talk to it.

onError.message: The setup conversation could not be started. Nothing was created.
